catalog.purpose: 簡報示範：每輪一個主要需求；接受模型提出的合理策略方案，閱讀確認單後只回覆「我同意」。不為沿用舊成果而改換策略；大盤比較與改善建議分輪提問。
catalog.prompt_origin: 主代理依使用者委託擔任示範操作者，逐輪回應 Sol 實際提出的問題；並非真人逐字對話。只有可見操作訊息與 MCP 結果交付，不包含私有推理。

cases.title: 從均線構想開始的 0050 研究
cases.idea: 我想用均線來買賣 0050，可以幫我看看嗎？
cases.story: 先討論買賣規則與必要選擇，再確認、執行、解讀及保存。

preselected_operator_answers.strategy_choice_when_proposed: 接受模型的合理提案，不指定沿用20日SMA；若需選擇，請模型建議。
preselected_operator_answers.annualization: 若追問年化，回覆「你幫我決定一個值就好。」不預先提供252；依模型實際回覆繼續。

catalog.reuse_of_market_cache: Copy only market cache into a new retained workspace; no prior conversation, strategies, plans, results or research notes loaded into this model thread.
catalog.date_interpretation: 以自然語言選定台灣日曆日期；依模型實際提出的確認單釐清並核對，不能預先把答案寫入問題。
catalog.conversation_recording: Native tradingdev-codex / ConversationService HTML and JSON; exact copies are delivered.
catalog.code_provenance: PR #188 合併後主線；本次僅製作案例與簡報，產品程式不變。
catalog.actual_annualization: 模型第2輪自行提出每年252日，操作者未預先提供數值。
catalog.accepted_strategy_proposal: 本次新對話的實際提案為5/20、10/40、20/60日三組SMA。操作者閱讀確認單後第3輪直接回覆「我同意」，未要求沿用舊案例設定。

report.navigation_instructions: 點選總覽表格或結果清單中的結果列，可進入該組參數的詳情；再以「返回」或「切換結果」查看其他組。已選取的詳情章節：設定與資料覆蓋、績效分析與保存指標、基準比較（Benchmark）、權益與回撤、委託、成交與帳戶核對、配對交易損益。所有內容保存在同一份離線 HTML。

archive.instructions: 下載 ZIP 後完整解壓，開啟 index.html；reports/ 保留連結報告。無下載網址時，path 是 server 本機路徑，需客戶端檔案傳輸能力。

copy_policy: Native conversation HTML/JSON, report, confirmation and ZIP are byte-identical copies. The overview and critique are presentation packaging, not the conversation record.

annual_return.description: Compounded annual growth rate of observed UTC daily returns using configured days per year. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

annual_volatility.description: Annualized sample standard deviation of observed daily returns. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

avg_holding_bars.description: Mean exit index minus entry index for closed trades.

calmar_ratio.description: Compounded annual return divided by maximum observed-day closing drawdown (daily_max_drawdown). Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_max_drawdown.description: Maximum observed-day closing percentage drawdown; denominator of Calmar ratio. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_pnl_max.description: max of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar daily periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_pnl_mean.description: mean of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar daily periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_pnl_median.description: median of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar daily periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_pnl_min.description: min of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar daily periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

daily_pnl_std.description: std of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar daily periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

max_drawdown.description: Largest peak-to-trough loss fraction, reported as nonnegative magnitude.

max_drawdown_amount.description: Largest peak-to-trough loss amount, including the initial capital/PnL baseline.

monthly_pnl_max.description: max of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar monthly periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

monthly_pnl_mean.description: mean of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar monthly periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

monthly_pnl_median.description: median of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar monthly periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

monthly_pnl_min.description: min of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar monthly periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

monthly_pnl_std.description: std of net PnL aggregated by observed UTC calendar monthly periods; std uses ddof=0. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

monthly_trades_mean.description: Closed trades divided by observed calendar months.

monthly_volume_mean.description: Executed notional divided by observed calendar months.

n_days.description: Number of observed UTC calendar dates.

n_months.description: Number of observed UTC calendar months.

open_trades.description: Number of trades still open at the final mark.

profit_factor.description: Closed-trade gross gains divided by absolute gross losses; all-winning is unbounded.

sharpe_ratio.description: Annualized excess daily return divided by sample standard deviation. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

sortino_ratio.description: Annualized return above target divided by downside deviation. Requires a recognized bar frequency of one day or finer; coarser or unknown bars cannot establish daily equity observations or allocate PnL across calendar boundaries.

total_fees.description: Total charged entry and exit commissions (see cost model metadata).

total_pnl.description: Net marked-to-market profit, including execution costs.

total_slippage.description: Explicit slippage charges in the volume model; signal slippage is embedded in fill prices.

total_trades.description: Number of closed trades; open trades excluded.

total_volume.description: Sum of actual entry and exit notional; open marks are not executions.

trade_expectancy.description: Expected net profit per closed trade.

win_rate.description: Fraction of closed trades with positive net PnL, after entry and exit costs.

definition.label: 台股加權指數（^TWII）買進持有
definition.rationale: 台灣掛牌標的統一使用台股加權指數作為市場基準，包含上市、上櫃及 ETF；此政策不代表標的的實際投資範圍都與台股大盤相同。使用 ^TWII 的價格報酬，未計入現金股利，因此不是含息總報酬指數。
